description: This file defines the 'CRT' class which acts as a wrapper for the AWS Common Runtime (CRT) in PHP. It provides static methods to interact with the CRT, such as error handling, logging, event loop group management, credential handling, HTTP message creation, signing, and checksum calculations. The class mainly manages an internal extension instance and offers various utilities for CRT operations within the AWS SDK ecosystem.

classes.name: CRT
classes.description: A singleton-like class providing static methods to interact with the AWS CRT, managing internal extension instantiation and offering utilities for error handling, logging, event loop, credentials, HTTP messaging, signing, and checksums.
